title: Matthew Stafford says he'll "hopefully" play more football beyond the 2026 season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Matthew Stafford says he'll "hopefully" play more football beyond the 2026 season
sources.description: “It is something delicate," Stafford said. "I've got to navigate the end of it, and I’m not sure when that is. I want to be fair to our team, but I also want to be fair to myself."
